handback.summary: No code change this round: the settings reader stands, and main now installs the YAML library.

criteria.793.1: `dokima/settings.py` reads `dokima/defaults.yaml` beside it; a missing or empty repo file gives the defaults.
criteria.793.2: `merge()` copies the defaults and changes only the keys the repo file names.
criteria.793.3: `dokima/defaults.yaml` holds every setting of the owner's list with its default.
criteria.793.4: `merge()` recurses into nested maps, key by key, the repo winning at each level.
criteria.793.5: `merge()` replaces any list whole with the repo's, an empty list included.
criteria.793.6: `by_name()` merges `gates.required` by name: same name replaces in place, new ones come after.
criteria.793.8: `merge()` warns naming the unknown key and the closest sibling key, via `difflib`.
criteria.793.9: `merge()` leaves unknown keys and groups out and the run goes on.
criteria.793.10: `read()` raises when the repo sets anything under `integrity`; `main()` exits 1 naming each locked key.
